planted.description: FORM user_command_0100 branches on CASE sy-ucomm instead of the OK_CODE variable ok_code. TOP declaration (DATA ok_code TYPE sy-ucomm) and screen OKCODE NAME=OK_CODE are correct; CASE sy-ucomm stays forbidden (MAJOR) under common/ok-code-pattern.md.
planted.detection_hint: Grep F include for "CASE sy-ucomm" inside FORM user_command_0100.
planted.fix: CASE ok_code. (copy to a local + CLEAR ok_code recommended, MINOR).

unavoidable_secondary_findings: ok_code is declared and bound but never read in ABAP — consequence of GS07-P1, not a separate finding.

must_not_flag.reason: Control references must survive PBO cycles and the grid table is the main data table — common/clean-code-procedural.md § Global vs Local allows the main data table; FORM headers document the side effect.

must_not_flag.reason: common/naming-conventions.md § Exceptions: ZSC4SAP_* harness objects in $TMP → §7 N/A (also listed in spec.md § Naming).

must_not_flag.construct: Objects are in $TMP without a transport request
must_not_flag.reason: Local golden-set objects; interview.md dim 6.

must_not_flag.construct: No verify-phase4.md for the screen / GUI status
must_not_flag.reason: Golden-set run feeds Phase 6 only; reviewers verify screens / statuses directly (run-plan.md).

must_not_flag.construct: Classic Open SQL without @ host-variable escaping / comma field lists
must_not_flag.reason: common/abap-release-reference.md § 1a: abapRelease 740 with abapSp unset → classic Open SQL, recorded in spec.md ("SP unknown — classic SQL").

must_not_flag.construct: Main program header block above REPORT (Module / Program ID / Tcode / Old Program ID / Title / Description + Change History)
must_not_flag.reason: common/clean-code-procedural.md § Mandatory Main Program Header (both paradigms); common/clean-code.md § Comments names it as the one allowed banner.

must_not_flag.reason: common/clean-code-procedural.md § Global vs Local: "DATA inside a FORM, METHOD or MODULE body is local and allowed"; phase6-review.md §6.

must_not_flag.construct: No SELECT COUNT(*) pre-check / no secondary key on the result table
must_not_flag.reason: SFLIGHT / SCARR are small demo tables, not the transactional tables the clean-code.md secondary-key / COUNT rule names.

must_not_flag.reason: Message types come from constants — compliant with common/constant-rule.md.

must_not_flag.reason: common/constant-rule.md § Exceptions: field catalog modification.

must_not_flag.reason: Explicit handling of the empty result; not an empty branch.

must_not_flag.construct: No AUTHORITY-CHECK before the SFLIGHT / SCARR reads
must_not_flag.reason: SAP demo data, not restricted business data (common/clean-code.md § Security and Data Handling targets restricted data); harness exemption recorded in spec.md §8.

must_not_flag.reason: common/naming-conventions.md § Exceptions: never generated, never flagged. Not applicable here — no such include exists in this case; a finding about it is a false positive.

must_not_flag.construct: Flow logic lines are "MODULE status_0100." without an OUTPUT / INPUT keyword
must_not_flag.reason: Dynpro flow-logic syntax never carries OUTPUT/INPUT (phase6-review.md §1, phase4-verify.md a1/a2); the lines are uncommented. Regression guard.

must_not_flag.reason: Standard return from a called screen; not a magic screen number, not LEAVE PROGRAM error handling.
